posts.title: MEANING AND THE DATA MODEL
posts.description: Recently I participated in a LinkedIn exchange initiated by the following statement: “First-Order Predicate Logic is quietly breaking enterprise semantics. FOPL assumes meaning can be expressed as predicates applied to entities: subject → predicate → object That works beautifully in theory. It fails in practice. Because the predicate is where ambiguity hides. So you can build vast semantic graphs
